linear_comparison_note: Ridge-regularized linear regression (alpha=100), original fixed candidate, same features/windows/hours; not ordinary unregularized least squares or coefficient inference.

primary_paired_bootstrap.method: Seeded moving calendar-block bootstrap; approximate, conditional on this dataset and fitted methods

residual_diagnostics.note: Correlations align by elapsed calendar hour, not adjacent surviving rows. Errors are dependent; no independent-hour inference or naive coefficient p-values.

revision.status: Single post-audit retrospective experiment; 2025/26 results already inspected before this design. No new untouched test or operational guarantee.
revision.method: Monthly recent-label refits of fixed original boosting; trailing 365-day signed prequential errors for equal-tail 90% intervals. No bias correction, new feature or hyperparameter search.
revision.caution: Earlier-model out-of-sample errors may not match a new refit under drift. Empirical intervals have no time-series coverage guarantee.
